title: Realize the rational force and its robust small-basin return
statement: Choose rational lambda with |lambda-nu kappa^2|<=zeta by finite certified Machin-series arithmetic. Force f=[alpha_prime+lambda alpha]sin(kappa x_j)e_i has fifteen rational polynomial pieces of degree<=1; comparison shear starts/ends zero and residual integral<=12zeta AT. Relative energy for EVERY admitted weak realization and disturbance<=eta gives ||U(tau)||2<=exp(12kappa AT)(||U0||2+tau eta+12zeta AT) for5T<=tau, force zero after loop. With kappa<7 and AT=2^(5n), choose R=(epsilon/16)2^(-128AT), eta=(epsilon/(16tau))2^(-128AT), zeta=(epsilon/(192AT))2^(-128AT). Then ||U0||2<=R implies endpoint<epsilon. Coefficients, heights and complete arithmetic costs are finite computable and paid. This robust all-weak result has exponentially shrinking SMALL basin R, not the requested arbitrary H1 radius M>=1; ordinary nonlinear growth exp(C2^(5n)) overwhelms the available exp(-c sqrt(nu)2^n) linear factor.
